units.source_text: 这时，只见一个身穿陆军军服的年轻上官从里首走了出来。

en.t: At that moment, a young superior officer in an army uniform came out from the inner room.

units.source_text: 他彬彬有利，正襟危坐在距女子近一米的地方，面对着女子。

en.t: He was polite and composed, sitting upright almost a meter away from the woman, facing her.

units.source_text: 两人纹丝不动，久久地相对而坐。

en.t: The two of them sat facing each other for a long time, without moving at all.
